content:
Looking at the diameter AB, the straight angle from OB to OA (going through the left side) is 180°.

The angles on this side are: 40° (between OB and the upper edge of the shaded sector), the shaded sector's angle, 30°, and 45° (down to OA).

So the shaded sector's central angle = 180° − 40° − 30° − 45° = 65°.

The probability is the ratio of the sector's area to the disk's area, which equals the ratio of angles:
65° / 360° = 13/72.

\boxed{13/72}
